title: sig_verify.rs: rsa::signature::Verifier used on ECDSA keys is confusing
description: smime-tree/src/sig_verify.rs lines 61, 83 call rsa::signature::Verifier::verify() on P256VerifyingKey/P384VerifyingKey. Works because rsa and p256/p384 share the same signature trait version, but reads like RSA verification is being done on ECDSA keys. Fix: import 'use signature::Verifier as _;' and call verifying_key.verify() without the rsa:: prefix.
